title: Existence of a hard function under a circuit-count bound
statement: Let $n,S$ be natural numbers satisfying $(S+1)\bigl(3(S+1)^2\bigr)^S S<2^{2^n}$. Then there is a Boolean function on $n$ input bits such that every well-formed acyclic Boolean circuit with at most two inputs to each gate and size at most $S$ disagrees with it on at least one input.
